title: Katabasis Storage Envelope v1
description: Self-describing JSON envelope for versioned Katabasis documents.

envelopeVersion.description: Envelope format version. Always '1' for this schema.

type.description: Stable logical entity type. Must not be a Java class name.

id.description: Unique identifier for this document within its type.

schemaVersion.description: Payload schema version. Incremented when the payload structure changes.

revision.description: Monotonic revision counter for optimistic concurrency. Zero for new documents.

payload.description: The serialized domain object. Schema is defined per entity type and schemaVersion.
